exact_admission: retained original registered source operation, continuation ID, canonical original prepare digest and saved scope; exact original admitted activation operation; fresh registered-key proof; current membership and original creator approval; no caller-selected actor

read_semantics.committed: exact original commercial result and matching durable delivery basis; no bearer, offer or new authority; use existing capability-license-delivery-recovery:v1 for delivery
read_semantics.expired-uncommitted: source deadline passed and complete original admission history proves no original commit under the commercial owner fence; original operation cannot now commit; no replacement or new offer permission
read_semantics.unresolved: source remains live or retained evidence cannot establish a terminal outcome; no mutation permission

committed_delivery: ADR0034 unchanged; independent existing delivery read/recover remains authoritative and does not require this read or fresh browser authentication
retention: bounded by original registered source evidence; no credentials or new retained offer; missing historical source/admission is not proof of noncommit
